about.title: About Annelis
about.lead: Mortgage Loan Originator at NEXA Lending and Real Estate Agent — I combine financial strategy, education, and a human approach at every stage of the buying and investment process.
about.body: With a university background in accounting and more than five years of experience in the US mortgage and real estate industry, I've helped 197+ families and buyers prepare financially, organize their credit, and make smart decisions to build wealth through real estate. Beyond financing, I focus on strategic, personalized guidance — adapting every solution to each family's real goals. Wife and mother of four, my mission is to help others reach long-term stability, security, and financial growth.

items.title: Educate before selling
items.body: Before talking about a loan or a property, I teach you how the system works so you can make the best decision — with clarity and honesty.

items.title: Strategic preparation
items.body: Organize finances, credit, and goals BEFORE buying. Preparation is 80% of the result.

items.title: Long-term vision
items.body: Every home purchase is more than a transaction: it is the opportunity to transform your family's future and create a lasting legacy.
